en.t: Antonius Primus enters Rome to claim the title of Emperor for Nero's former general Vespasian
en.s: Marcus Antonius Primus (born between 20 AD and 35 AD – died after 81 AD) was a senator and general of the Roman Empire. He played a crucial role in Vespasian's accession during the turbulent Year of the Four Emperors, defeating the forces of emperor Vitellius and capturing Rome.

zh.t: 安东尼乌斯·普里穆斯率军进入罗马，扶持维斯帕芗称帝
zh.s: 马库斯·安东尼乌斯·普里穆斯（生于公元20年至35年间，卒于公元81年后）是罗马帝国的元老和将领。他在“四帝之年”的动荡局势中对维斯帕芗登基起到关键作用，击败维泰里乌斯皇帝的军队并攻占罗马。

en.t: Byzantine Emperor Romanos I Lekapenos is arrested by two of his sons, forced to abdicate and to live as a monk for the rest of his life
en.s: Romanos I Lakapenos or Lekapenos (Greek: Ῥωμανός Λακαπηνός or Λεκαπηνός, romanized: Rōmanos Lakapēnos or Lekapēnos; c. 870 – 15 June 948), Latinized as Romanus I Lacapenus or Romanus I Lecapenus, was Byzantine emperor from 920 until his deposition in 944, serving as regent for and senior co-ruler of the young Constantine VII.

zh.t: 拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯一世遭两名儿子逮捕，被迫退位并出家为僧
zh.s: 罗曼努斯一世·莱卡佩诺斯（希腊语：Ῥωμανός Λακαπηνός或Λεκαπηνός，转写：Rōmanos Lakapēnos或Lekapēnos；约870年—948年6月15日），拉丁化名为Romanus I Lacapenus或Romanus I Lecapenus，于920年至944年间担任拜占庭皇帝。被废黜前，他曾担任年轻的君士坦丁七世摄政，并与其共同执政。

en.t: Emperor Henry III convenes the synod of Sutri to mediate between different claimants to the papacy
en.s: Henry III (German: Heinrich III, 28 October 1016 – 5 October 1056), called Heinrich the Pious, was Holy Roman Emperor from 1046 until his death in 1056. A member of the Salian dynasty, he was the eldest son of Conrad II and Gisela of Swabia. Henry was raised by his father, who made him Duke of Bavaria in 1026, appointed him co-ruler in 1028 and bestowed him with the duchy of Swabia and the Kingdom of Burgundy ten years later in 1038.

zh.t: 亨利三世在苏特里召开宗教会议，调解教宗职位的多名竞争者
zh.s: 亨利三世（德语：Heinrich III；1016年10月28日—1056年10月5日），又称虔诚者海因里希，自1046年至去世一直担任神圣罗马帝国皇帝。他是萨利安王朝成员，父亲是康拉德二世，母亲是施瓦本的吉塞拉。亨利由父亲抚养长大；父亲于1026年任命他为巴伐利亚公爵，1028年立他为共治国王，1038年又授予他施瓦本公国和勃艮第王国。

en.s: The Battle of Amroha was fought on 20 December 1305 between the armies of the Delhi Sultanate of India and the Mongol Chagatai Khanate of Central Asia. The Delhi force led by Malik Nayak defeated the Mongol army led by Ali Beg and Tartaq near Amroha in present-day Uttar Pradesh.

zh.s: 阿姆罗哈战役发生于1305年12月20日，交战双方为印度德里苏丹国军队和中亚蒙古察合台汗国军队。马利克·纳亚克率领的德里军队在今北方邦阿姆罗哈附近击败了阿里·别格和塔尔塔克率领的蒙古军队。

en.t: Cardinal Jacques Fournier, a Cistercian monk, is elected Pope Benedict XII
en.s: Pope Benedict XII (Latin: Benedictus XII, Italian: Benedetto XII, French: Benoît XII; 1285 – 25 April 1342), born Jacques Fournier, was a cardinal and inquisitor, and later, head of the Catholic Church from 30 December 1334 to his death, in April 1342. He was the third Avignon pope and reformed monastic orders and opposed nepotism. Unable to remove his capital to Rome or Bologna, Benedict started the great palace at Avignon.

zh.t: 枢机主教雅克·富尼耶当选教宗本笃十二世
zh.s: 教宗本笃十二世（拉丁语：Benedictus XII；意大利语：Benedetto XII；法语：Benoît XII；1285年—1342年4月25日）本名雅克·富尼耶，曾任枢机主教和宗教裁判官，后于1334年12月30日起担任天主教会领袖，直至1342年4月去世。他是第三位阿维尼翁教宗，曾改革修会制度并反对任人唯亲。由于无法将教廷首都迁往罗马或博洛尼亚，本笃十二世在阿维尼翁兴建了宏伟的宫殿。

en.s: The fall of the Serbian Empire was a decades-long process in the late 14th century. Following the death of the childless Emperor Stefan Uroš V in 1371, the Serbian Empire was left without an heir and the magnates, velikaši, obtained the rule of its provinces and districts (in so-called feudal fragmentation), continuing their offices as independent with titles such as gospodin, and despot, given to them during the Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚帝国的衰亡是14世纪后期历时数十年的过程。无嗣的斯特凡·乌罗什五世皇帝于1371年去世后，帝国失去继承人；各地贵族（velikaši）掌握了所属行省和地区的统治权，在封建割据中以君主或专制君主等头衔继续执政，这些头衔原本是在帝国时期授予的。

en.s: The Sack of Delhi took place on 17 December 1398 between Timur – founder of the Timurid Empire – and Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah, the Sultan of Delhi. The Sultan had war elephants among his ranks, something unknown to the steppe warriors at the time. Timur might have had camels loaded with kindling that was set on fire, releasing them to spread panic among the Indian elephants, who then trampled the sultan’s soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帖木儿于1398年12月17日攻陷德里，与其交战的是德里苏丹纳西尔丁·马哈茂德·沙阿。苏丹军中有当时草原部族战士并不熟悉的战象。据称，帖木儿可能让骆驼驮着引火物并点燃，然后放出骆驼惊吓印度战象；受惊的战象转而踩踏苏丹的士兵。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Jayakarta War (Indonesian: Perang Jayakarta; Dutch: Jayakarta-oorlog) was a military conflict in Jayakarta, Indonesia from 1618 to 1619 fought by an alliance of the British East India Company (EIC) and Jayakartan forces against the Dutch East India Company (VOC). The Anglo-Jayakartan forces inflicted significant losses on the Dutch during the war, and many Dutch lodges and forts were captured with the help of the Bantenese.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 雅加达战争（印度尼西亚语：Perang Jayakarta；荷兰语：Jayakarta-oorlog）是1618年至1619年在印度尼西亚雅加达发生的一场军事冲突，交战双方是英国东印度公司与雅加达军队组成的联盟，以及荷兰东印度公司。英雅联军在战斗中重创荷兰人，并在万丹人的协助下攻占了多处荷兰驻地和堡垒。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Gadebusch or Wakenstädt (20 December 1712) was Sweden's final great victory in the Great Northern War. It was fought by the Swedes to prevent the loss of the city of Stralsund to Danish and Saxon forces.

zh.s: 加德布施战役，也称瓦肯施泰特战役，发生于1712年12月20日，是瑞典在大北方战争中的最后一场重大胜利。瑞典军队为阻止丹麦和萨克森军队夺取施特拉尔松而参战。

en.s: The Battle of Cape St Vincent was fought on 20 December 1719 as part of the War of the Quadruple Alliance. Occurring off Cape St. Vincent in the Atlantic Ocean, it was fought between a Royal Navy squadron of two ships of the line and a frigate under Commodore Philip Cavendish and a Spanish Navy squadron of three ships of the line under Rodrigo de Torres y Morales.

zh.s: 圣文森特角海战于1719年12月20日爆发，是四国同盟战争的一部分。战斗发生在大西洋圣文森特角附近，交战双方分别是菲利普·卡文迪什准将指挥的英国皇家海军分舰队（两艘战列舰和一艘护卫舰）与罗德里戈·德·托雷斯·莫拉莱斯指挥的西班牙海军分舰队（三艘战列舰）。

en.t: Prussian forces secure Breslau’s gates after the siege
en.s: By December 20, 1757, Prussian forces had control of all Breslau’s city gates after its Austrian-led defenders agreed to surrender. A letter from Frederick II dated at Breslau that day reported the surrender to Britain’s envoy. The Austrian and French garrison marched out the following day. Breslau is now Wrocław, Poland.
en.n: Prussian control of the gates and Frederick’s dated surrender report; the garrison marched out on December 21.

zh.t: 普鲁士军队控制布雷斯劳各处城门
zh.s: 1757年12月20日，奥地利方面的守军同意投降后，普鲁士军队已控制布雷斯劳的所有城门。腓特烈二世当天在布雷斯劳写信给英国使节，报告这座城市投降的消息。奥地利和法国守军于次日出城。布雷斯劳就是今天波兰的弗罗茨瓦夫。
zh.n: 记录普军控制城门及腓特烈当天报告投降；守军在12月21日出城。

en.s: The action of 19 December 1796 was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought in the last stages of the Mediterranean campaign between two British Royal Navy frigates and two Spanish Navy frigates off the coast of Murcia. The British squadron was the last remaining British naval force in the Mediterranean, sent to transport the British garrison of Elba to safety under the command of Commodore Horatio Nelson.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1796年12月19日海战是法国大革命战争地中海战役末期的一场小规模海战，交战双方为英国皇家海军的两艘护卫舰和西班牙海军的两艘护卫舰，地点在穆尔西亚海岸附近。霍雷肖·纳尔逊准将率领的英国分舰队是当时英国在地中海仅存的海军力量，奉命护送厄尔巴岛的英国驻军转移至安全地带。

en.t: Reassertion of British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands (1833)
en.s: In December 1832, the United Kingdom sent two naval vessels to re-assert British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands (Spanish: Islas Malvinas), after the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata (part of which later became Argentina) ignored British diplomatic protests over the appointment of Luis Vernet as governor of the Falkland Islands and a dispute over fishing rights.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 英国重申对福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）的主权（1833年）
zh.s: 1832年12月，英国派出两艘军舰，重申对福克兰群岛（西班牙语：Islas Malvinas）的主权。此前，拉普拉塔联合省（其部分领土后来成为阿根廷）无视了英国针对路易斯·韦尔内被任命为福克兰群岛总督一事，以及捕鱼权争端提出的外交抗议。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Sarawak Uprising of 1836 or informally known as the Siniawan War was an armed conflict against Brunei led by a former governor of Sarawak, Datu Patinggi Ali. This war would lead to the demise of the Bruneian Empire and would open the doors of a new Sarawak after the war's end under the White Rajah, James Brooke who would modernise Sarawak to the European standard.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1836年砂拉越起义也称西尼亚万战争，是达图·帕丁吉·阿里领导的一场反抗文莱的武装冲突。这场战争导致文莱帝国衰亡，并在战争结束后开启了由白拉惹詹姆斯·布鲁克统治的新砂拉越时代；他推动砂拉越按欧洲标准进行现代化。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1842 Newfoundland general election was held on December 20, 1842, to elect the members of the 3rd General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. The original constitution was suspended following conflict between the House of Assembly and the Legislative Council, and Governor John Harvey combined the two legislatures into an amalgamated assembly.

zh.s: 1842年12月20日，纽芬兰殖民地举行大选，选出第三届纽芬兰议会的议员。此前，众议院与立法会发生冲突，原宪法因此被暂停；总督约翰·哈维将两院合并为一个议会。

en.t: French presidential election: Having won the popular vote in a landslide, Louis Napoleon Bonaparte is inaugurated in the chamber of the National Assembly as the first (and only) president of the French Second Republic
en.s: Presidential elections were held for the first time in France on 10 and 11 December 1848, electing the first and only president of the Second Republic. This election marked the birth of the Second Republic and the dramatic end of the July Monarchy, a transformation born of the February Revolution's fervour. The election ended in a landslide victory for Louis-Napoléon Bonaparte, nephew of Napoleon I, who won 74% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 法国总统选举：路易-拿破仑·波拿巴以压倒性优势赢得普选票，并在国民议会会议厅宣誓就任法兰西第二共和国首任且唯一一任总统
zh.s: 法国于1848年12月10日至11日首次举行总统选举，选出第二共和国首任且唯一一任总统。选举标志着第二共和国诞生，也宣告七月王朝结束。拿破仑一世的侄子路易-拿破仑·波拿巴以74%的普选票大胜。

en.t: 1849 United States Senate elections in California
en.s: The 1849 United States Senate elections in California were held on December 20, 1849, by the California State Legislature to elect two U.S. Senators (Class 1 and Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Democrats John C. Frémont and William M. Gwin were elected over several other challengers.

zh.t: 1849年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1849年12月20日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出两名参议员（第一类和第三类）代表加利福尼亚州进入联邦参议院。民主党人约翰·C·弗里蒙特和威廉·M·格温击败多名对手当选。

en.s: The Battle of Berea was a battle between British forces under Sir George Cathcart and Basuto-Taung forces under King Moshoeshoe I that took place on 20 December 1852. The battle began when British forces broke into three columns and crossed the Caledon River in southern Africa, with the goal of seizing Basuto cattle as a form of punishment for past Basuto cattle raiding.

zh.s: 贝雷亚战役发生于1852年12月20日，交战双方是乔治·卡思卡特爵士率领的英军和莫舒舒一世国王率领的巴苏陀—陶恩部队。英军分成三路渡过南部非洲的卡莱登河后发动进攻，目的是夺取巴苏陀人的牛群，以惩罚其此前的劫牛行动。

en.t: 1860 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: A senatorial election was held in Arkansas on December 20, 1860, as part of the 1860–61 United States Senate elections. The Democratic former Arkansas representative Charles B. Mitchel defeated Samuel H. Hempstead and the former chief justice of the Arkansas Supreme Court George C. Watkins. The incumbent senator Robert W. Johnson did not seek re-election. The Arkansas General Assembly met on December 20, 1860, to elect Johnson's successor.

zh.t: 1860年阿肯色州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1860年12月20日，阿肯色州举行联邦参议员选举，这是1860—1861年美国联邦参议员选举的一部分。民主党人、前阿肯色州众议员查尔斯·B·米切尔击败塞缪尔·H·亨普斯特德以及前阿肯色州最高法院首席法官乔治·C·沃特金斯。时任参议员罗伯特·W·约翰逊未寻求连任。阿肯色州议会于当天开会，选举约翰逊的继任者。

en.s: The Battle of Dranesville was a small battle during the American Civil War that took place between Confederate forces under Brigadier General J. E. B. Stuart and Union forces under Brigadier General Edward O. C. Ord on December 20, 1861, in Fairfax County, Virginia, as part of Major General George B. McClellan's operations in northern Virginia. The two forces on similar winter-time patrols encountered and engaged one another in the crossroads village of Dranesville. The battle resulted in a Union victory.

zh.s: 德雷恩斯维尔战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模战斗，于1861年12月20日在弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县爆发。南方邦联军由准将J·E·B·斯图尔特率领，联邦军由准将爱德华·O·C·奥德率领，双方当时都在乔治·B·麦克莱伦少将指挥下于弗吉尼亚北部行动。两支部队在冬季巡逻时于德雷恩斯维尔的十字路口村庄相遇并交战，最终联邦军获胜。

en.s: The Holly Springs Raid (December 20, 1862) saw Earl Van Dorn lead Confederate cavalry against a Union supply depot at Holly Springs, Mississippi during the American Civil War. The mounted raiders achieved complete surprise, capturing the Federal garrison and destroying $1.5 million of supplies intended for Ulysses S. Grant's army. In the following days, Van Dorn's troopers moved north along the Mississippi Central Railroad almost to Bolivar, Tennessee, destroying track and bridges, before escaping into northern Mississippi.

zh.s: 1862年12月20日，美国内战期间，南方邦联骑兵在厄尔·范多恩率领下突袭了密西西比州霍利斯普林斯的联邦军补给站。骑兵出其不意地俘虏了联邦驻军，并摧毁了价值150万美元、原本供尤利西斯·S·格兰特部队使用的物资。此后几天，范多恩的骑兵沿密西西比中央铁路北上，几乎抵达田纳西州博利瓦尔，途中破坏铁路和桥梁，最后逃回密西西比州北部。

en.t: 1867 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1867 United States Senate election in California was held on December 20, 1867, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Democratic State Printer Eugene Casserly was elected over fellow Democratic former Congressman from Illinois Joseph P. Hoge.

zh.t: 1867年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1867年12月20日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出一名第一类参议员代表该州进入联邦参议院。在一次特别联席会议上，前民主党州印刷官尤金·卡瑟利击败民主党前国会议员约瑟夫·H·霍格，当选参议员。

en.s: The Battle of Monnaie, also known as the Battle of Tours was a battle of the Franco-Prussian War. It took place on the December 20, 1870 at Indre-et-Loire, France. During this engagement, a Hanover division of the Imperial German Army under the command of General Schwarzkoppen, belonging to Legion X under the command of Konstantin Bernhard von Voigts-Rhetz attacked and won the victory against an army of Garde Mobile's 234 led by General Ferry Pisani, driving the French to Langreais.

zh.s: 莫奈战役又称图尔战役，是普法战争期间的一场战斗，于1870年12月20日在法国安德尔-卢瓦尔省爆发。施瓦茨科彭将军指挥的德意志帝国军汉诺威师隶属康斯坦丁·伯恩哈德·冯·福伊茨-雷茨指挥的第十军团；该师进攻并击败了费里·皮萨尼将军率领的第234机动国民警卫队，迫使法军撤退至朗格雷。

en.t: 1871 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1871 United States Senate election in California was held on December 20, 1871, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, Republican Congressman Aaron A. Sargent was elected over Democratic State Supreme Court Justice William T. Wallace.

zh.t: 1871年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1871年12月20日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出一名第三类参议员代表该州进入联邦参议院。在一次特别联席会议上，共和党众议员亚伦·A·萨金特击败民主党州最高法院法官威廉·T·华莱士，当选参议员。

en.s: The 1875–1876 New Zealand general election was held between 20 December 1875 and 29 January 1876 to elect a total of 88 MPs in 73 electorates to the 6th session of the New Zealand Parliament. The Māori vote was held on 4 and 15 January 1876. A total of 56,471 voters were registered.

zh.s: 1875—1876年新西兰大选于1875年12月20日至1876年1月29日举行，选出88名议员，代表73个选区进入新西兰第六届议会。毛利人选举于1876年1月4日和15日举行。登记选民共56,471人。

en.s: The 1876 Christchurch City mayoral election was the first election for the Mayor of Christchurch held by public vote. The election, held on 20 December, was won by James Gapes, who beat fellow city councillor Charles Thomas Ick.

zh.s: 1876年12月20日举行的基督城市长选举，是该市首次由公众投票选举市长。詹姆斯·盖普斯击败同为市议员的查尔斯·托马斯·艾克，当选市长。

en.s: The Battle of Bronkhorstspruit was the first major engagement of the First Boer War. It took place by the Bronkhorstspruit river, near the town of Bronkhorstspruit, Transvaal, on 20 December 1880. Threatened by the growing numbers of militant Boers in the Pretoria region, the British recalled the 94th Regiment of Foot, which had several companies garrisoned in towns and villages across the wider area.

zh.t: 布龙克霍斯特斯普鲁特战役
zh.s: 布龙克霍斯特斯普鲁特战役是第一次布尔战争中的首场重大战斗，于1880年12月20日在德兰士瓦的布龙克霍斯特斯普鲁特镇附近爆发。由于比勒陀利亚地区的武装布尔人不断增多，英国召回了第94步兵团；该团当时有几个连驻扎在当地各城镇和村庄。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 20 December 1881. Supporters of Charilaos Trikoupis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 125 of the 245 seats. Trikoupis became Prime Minister on 15 March 1883.

zh.s: 希腊于1881年12月20日举行议会选举。哈里劳斯·特里库皮斯的支持者成为议会中最大的阵营，在245个席位中赢得125席。特里库皮斯于1883年3月15日出任首相。

en.s: The Battle of Suakin (also known as the Battle of Gemaizah) occurred on 20 December 1888 when Francis Grenfell defeated the Mahdi forces near Suakin, a chief port of Sudan. After one and a half hours of fighting, the casualties were 12 on the side of the British and Egyptians, and 1,000 on the side of the Arabs. In this battle, three of the swords of the 20th Hussars broke short, an incident which later caused debate in the House of Commons of the United Kingdom. From Suakin, a sortie was launched against Osman Digna and his Dervish forces, who were attempting to capture the Water Forts.

zh.s: 萨瓦金战役又称杰迈扎战役，发生于1888年12月20日。弗朗西斯·格伦费尔在苏丹重要港口萨瓦金附近击败马赫迪军。战斗持续一个半小时，英埃一方伤亡12人，阿拉伯一方伤亡1000人。第20轻骑兵团有三把军刀在战斗中折断，后来此事还在英国下议院引发争论。此后，英军从萨瓦金出击，袭击正试图夺取水上堡垒的奥斯曼·迪格纳及其德尔维希部队。

en.s: The Korean Empire invasion of Manchuria was an invasion of Manchuria (Northeast China, then ruled by the Qing dynasty) by the Korean Empire. The attack began on 11 August 1902, when Gojong of Korea sent Yi Bum-yun to Jiandao (also called "Gando" in Korea) as an observer. The attack ended in victory for Korea, which gained some control over Jiandao until the Gando Convention of 1909.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 大韩帝国军队入侵当时由清朝统治的满洲（中国东北）。1902年8月11日，高宗派李范允前往间岛（韩国也称“干岛”）担任观察员，行动由此开始。韩国最终取胜，并在1909年《间岛协约》签署前取得对间岛的部分控制权。

en.s: The 1911 North Ayrshire by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 20 December 1911. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1911年北艾尔郡补选于12月20日举行。这是一场英国议会补选，选出一名下议院议员，采用简单多数制。

en.s: The Capture of Korytsa by the Hellenic armed forces, happened on 20 December 1912, during the First Balkan War.

zh.s: 1912年12月20日，希腊武装部队在第一次巴尔干战争期间攻占科尔察。

en.s: The First Battle of Champagne (French: 1ère Bataille de Champagne) was fought from 20 December 1914 – 17 March 1915 in World War I in the Champagne region of France. The battle was fought by the French Fourth Army and the German 3rd Army. It was the first offensive by the Allies against the Germans since mobile warfare had ended after the Race to the Sea from 17 September – 19 October and the defensive battles in Flanders of the Battle of the Yser and the First Battle of Ypres from 19 October – 22 November 1914.

zh.s: 第一次香槟战役是第一次世界大战期间法国香槟地区的一场战役，发生于1914年12月20日至1915年3月17日。交战双方为法国第四集团军和德国第三集团军。这是自机动作战在海向竞赛（1914年9月17日至10月19日）结束、以及伊瑟河战役和第一次伊普尔战役（1914年10月19日至11月22日）等佛兰德斯防御战之后，协约国首次对德军发动攻势。

en.t: On 20 December 1917, the Council of People's Commissars officially established the All-Russia Extraordinary Commission to Combat Counter-revolution and Sabotage—commonly known as the Cheka (based on the Russian acronym ВЧК)
en.s: Felix Edmundovich Dzerzhinsky (11 September [O.S. 30 August] 1877 – 20 July 1926), nicknamed Iron Felix (Russian: Железный Феликс), was a Bolshevik revolutionary and politician of Polish origin. From 1917 until his death in 1926, he led the first three Soviet secret police organizations—the Cheka, the GPU and the OGPU—establishing state security organs for the new Soviet government.

zh.t: 人民委员会于1917年12月20日正式成立全俄肃清反革命及怠工非常委员会（简称契卡）
zh.s: 费利克斯·埃德蒙多维奇·捷尔任斯基（1877年9月11日〔旧历8月30日〕—1926年7月20日），绰号“铁腕费利克斯”，是波兰裔布尔什维克革命家和政治人物。1917年至1926年去世前，他领导了苏联最初的三个秘密警察机构——契卡、国家政治保卫局和国家政治保卫总局，为新苏维埃政府建立国家安全机关。

en.s: The Spen Valley by-election of 1919 was held on 20 December 1919. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Coalition Liberal MP, Thomas Palmer Whittaker. It was won by the Labour candidate Tom Myers, who had contested the constituency at the 1918 general election The poll came at the same time as a serious split in the Liberal Party over continuing support for the coalition government: Colonel B C Fairfax was nominated as the Coalition Liberal candidate while Sir John Simon stood as an Independent Liberal.

zh.s: 1919年斯彭谷补选于12月20日举行，起因是在任联合自由党议员托马斯·帕尔默·惠特克去世。工党候选人汤姆·迈尔斯赢得选举；他此前曾在1918年大选中角逐该选区。此次投票期间，自由党正因是否继续支持联合政府而严重分裂：联合自由党提名了B·C·费尔法克斯上校，约翰·西蒙爵士则以独立自由党人身份参选。

en.s: General elections were held in Romania in December 1937. The Chamber of Deputies was elected on 20 December, whilst the Senate was elected in three stages on 22, 28 and 30 December. Voting was by universal male suffrage, making them the last elections held before women could vote. The National Liberal Party remained the largest party, winning 152 of the 387 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 97 of the 112 the Senate seats.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1937年12月举行大选。众议院选举于12月20日举行，参议院选举则分三轮，分别在12月22日、28日和30日举行。选举采用男性普选制，这是女性获得投票权前举行的最后一次选举。国家自由党仍是最大党，在众议院387席中赢得152席，在参议院112席中赢得97席。

en.t: The "joint technical commissions" required by the pact were established by agreement on 20 December 1940
en.s: The Tripartite Pact, also known as the Berlin Pact, was an agreement between Germany, Italy, and Japan signed in Berlin on 27 September 1940 by, respectively, Joachim von Ribbentrop, Galeazzo Ciano, and Saburō Kurusu (in that order) and in the presence of Adolf Hitler. It was a defensive military alliance that was eventually joined by Hungary (20 November 1940), Romania (23 November 1940), Slovakia (24 November 1940), Bulgaria (1 March 1941), and Yugoslavia (25 March 1941).

zh.t: 三国同盟协议要求成立的“联合技术委员会”于1940年12月20日设立
zh.s: 三国同盟又称《柏林条约》，是德国、意大利和日本于1940年9月27日在柏林签署的防御性军事同盟，签署者依次为约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫、加莱亚佐·齐亚诺和来栖三郎，阿道夫·希特勒在场。匈牙利、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克、保加利亚和南斯拉夫后来也加入该同盟。

en.t: Captain America Comics #1, containing the first appearance of the superhero Captain America, is published
en.s: Captain America is a superhero created by Joe Simon and Jack Kirby who appears in American comic books published by Marvel Comics. The character first appeared in Captain America Comics #1, published on December 20, 1940, by Timely Publications, a corporate predecessor to Marvel. Captain America's civilian identity is Steven "Steve" Rogers, a frail man rejected by the United States Army for physical unfitness who is enhanced to the peak of human physical perfection by an experimental "super-soldier serum".

zh.t: 《美国队长漫画》第1期出版，美国队长首次登场
zh.s: 美国队长是由乔·西蒙和杰克·柯比创作的超级英雄，出现在漫威漫画出版的美国漫画中。该角色于1940年12月20日首次登场，刊载于Timely Publications出版的《美国队长漫画》第1期；Timely Publications是漫威的前身。美国队长的真实身份是史蒂文（“史蒂夫”）·罗杰斯：他体弱多病，因身体条件不合格被美国陆军拒收，后来经实验性“超级士兵血清”改造，获得人类体能的巅峰。

en.s: The Kursk–Oboyan Offensive Operation in December 1941 – January 1942 was a front–line offensive operation of the Soviet Troops of the right wing of the Southwestern Front. An integral part of the winter counter–offensive of the Red Army of 1941–1942. Stubborn fighting in the Belgorod Direction continued for 70 days and ended in vain after mutual exhaustion of forces and the onset of mud.

zh.t: 库尔斯克—奥博扬进攻战役
zh.s: 库尔斯克—奥博扬进攻战役发生于1941年12月至1942年1月，是苏联西南方面军右翼部队发动的一次正面进攻，也是红军1941—1942年冬季反攻的一部分。别尔哥罗德方向的激战持续了70天，双方兵力均已耗尽、泥泞天气又至后，战役无果而终。

en.s: Operation Mars (Russian: Операция «Марс»), also known as the Second Rzhev-Sychevka Offensive Operation (Russian: Вторая Ржевско-Сычёвская наступательная операция), was the codename for an offensive launched by Soviet forces against German forces during World War II. It took place between 25 November and 20 December 1942 around the Rzhev salient in the vicinity of Moscow. The offensive was a joint operation of the Soviet Western Front and Kalinin Front co-ordinated by Georgy Zhukov.

zh.s: 火星行动（俄语：Операция «Марс»）又称第二次勒热夫—瑟乔夫卡进攻行动，是第二次世界大战期间苏军对德军发动的一次攻势的代号。行动于1942年11月25日至12月20日在莫斯科附近的勒热夫突出部展开，由苏联西方面军和加里宁方面军联合实施，格奥尔基·朱可夫负责协调。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Robson (20 December 1944) was the first of a series of aerial operations, Operation Outflank, undertaken by the British Pacific Fleet (BPF) against the oil refineries of Japanese-occupied Sumatra during World War II. Admiral Chester Nimitz, Commander in Chief, Pacific Ocean Areas, proposed a strike on the refineries to Admiral Bruce Fraser, commander of the BPF, during a meeting in early December.

zh.s: 罗布森行动于1944年12月20日展开，是英国太平洋舰队在第二次世界大战期间针对日占苏门答腊岛炼油厂发动的一系列“侧翼行动”空袭中的首次行动。太平洋海域总司令切斯特·尼米兹在12月初的一次会议上向英国太平洋舰队司令布鲁斯·弗雷泽提议轰炸炼油厂。

en.s: The Battle of Desivojca took place on 19 December 1944 during World War II, between Yugoslav Partisans and Balli Kombëtar forces, in the territory of German occupied Albania.

en.t: An earthquake in Nankaidō, Japan causes a tsunami which kills at least one thousand people and destroys 36,000 homes
en.s: The 1946 Nankai earthquake (昭和南海地震 Shōwa Nankai jishin) was a great earthquake in Nankaidō, Japan. It occurred on December 21, 1946, at 04:19 JST (December 20, 19:19 UTC). The earthquake measured between 8.1 and 8.4 on the moment magnitude scale, and was felt from Northern Honshū to Kyūshū. It occurred more than two years after the 1944 Tōnankai earthquake, which ruptured the adjacent part of the Nankai megathrust.

zh.t: 日本南海海槽地震引发海啸，造成至少1000人死亡、36000栋房屋被毁
zh.s: 1946年南海地震发生在日本南海道，是一次强烈地震。地震发生于日本标准时间1946年12月21日4时19分（协调世界时12月20日19时19分）。震级介于矩震级8.1至8.4级之间，震感从本州北部延伸至九州。此前两年多发生的1944年东南海地震，曾撕裂南海海槽相邻的一段。

en.s: The Jingshan–Zhongxiang Campaign was a half-year-long struggle in Hubei between the nationalists and the communists for the control of Jingshan and Zhongxiang regions during the Chinese Civil War; it resulted in communist victory. In the second half of 1947, Liu Bocheng, Deng Xiaoping and Li Xiannian decided to reestablish Jianghan (江汉) Military Region by combining the communist 5th Division from southern Shaanxi and the communist force in western Hubei in the Dabie Mountains, and Zhao Jimei (赵基梅) was named as the first commander.

zh.s: 京山—钟祥战役是中国内战期间国共双方为争夺湖北京山和钟祥地区控制权而进行的一场持续半年之久的战役，最终以共产党方面获胜告终。1947年下半年，刘伯承、邓小平和李先念决定整合来自陕西南部的共产党第五师与鄂西部队，在大别山重建江汉军区，并任命赵基梅为首任司令员。

en.t: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Liuwandashan
en.s: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Liuwandashan was a counter-guerrilla / counterinsurgency campaign the communists fought against the nationalist guerrilla that was mostly consisted of bandits and nationalist regular troops left behind after the nationalist regime withdrew from mainland China. The campaign was fought during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era in the region of Liuwandashan (六万大山, literally meaning Sixty-Thousand Great Mountains) in Guangxi and resulted in communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 六万大山剿匪战役是共产党在中国内战及二战后时期开展的一次反游击、反叛乱行动，对手是以土匪和国民党政权撤出中国大陆后留下的国民党正规军为主的游击队。战役发生在广西六万大山地区，最终以共产党方面获胜告终。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 20 December 1951. The election was the first in Antigua and Barbuda to be held under universal suffrage. Vere Bird formed the Antigua Labour Party in 1951 and led the party to victory, winning all eight elected seats on the legislative council. Voter turnout was 70%.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1951年12月20日举行大选。这是该国首次实行普选。维尔·伯德于1951年创立安提瓜工党并率其赢得选举，拿下立法委员会全部8个民选席位。投票率为70%。

en.s: The 1952 Moses Lake C-124 crash was an accident in which a United States Air Force Douglas C-124 Globemaster II military transport aircraft crashed near Moses Lake, Washington on December 20, 1952. Of the 115 people on board, 87 died and 28 survived. The crash was the world's deadliest aviation disaster at the time, surpassing the Llandow air disaster, which killed 80 people.

zh.s: 1952年12月20日，美国空军一架道格拉斯C-124“环球霸王II”军用运输机在华盛顿州摩西湖附近坠毁。机上115人中，87人遇难，28人生还。这起空难当时是全球死亡人数最多的航空事故，超过了此前造成80人死亡的兰德洛空难。

en.t: UK government says it will recognize Cardiff as Wales’s capital
en.s: In a written answer to Parliament on December 20, 1955, Home Secretary Gwilym Lloyd George said the British government would recognize Cardiff as the capital of Wales. He said no further formal measure was needed to put that decision into effect.

zh.t: 英国政府确认承认卡迪夫为威尔士首府
zh.s: 1955年12月20日，英国内政大臣格威利姆·劳埃德·乔治在给议会的书面答复中表示，政府将承认卡迪夫为威尔士首府，并认为无须再采取正式措施。

en.t: The initial production version of the Boeing 707 makes its first flight
en.s: The Boeing 707 is an early American long-range narrow-body airliner, the first jetliner developed and produced by Boeing Commercial Airplanes. Developed from the Boeing 367-80 prototype, the initial 707-120 first flew on December 20, 1957. Pan Am, the launch customer, began regular service with the 707 on October 26, 1958. With versions produced until 1979, the 707 is a swept wing quadjet with podded engines.

zh.t: 波音707首架量产型首次试飞
zh.s: 波音707是一款早期美国远程窄体客机，也是波音民用飞机集团研发并生产的首款喷气式客机。首架量产型707-120基于波音367-80原型机研制，于1957年12月20日首飞。首发客户泛美航空于1958年10月26日开始用707执飞定期航班。707有多个型号，生产持续至1979年；该机采用后掠翼、四台翼下吊挂发动机。

en.t: National Liberation Front of South Vietnam is founded in Tây Ninh
en.s: Representatives meeting in Tân Lập village in Tây Ninh Province founded the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam on December 20, 1960. The front became a major political organization in the conflict against the South Vietnamese government and its allies. This date marks the front’s founding, not the beginning of the wider Vietnam War.
en.n: Founding meeting at Tân Lập, Tây Ninh, on December 20, 1960.

zh.t: 越南南方民族解放阵线在西宁省成立
zh.s: 1960年12月20日，与会代表在越南西宁省新立村成立越南南方民族解放阵线。此后，该阵线成为反对南越政府及其盟友的重要政治组织。当天发生的是阵线成立，并非整个越南战争的开端。
zh.n: 当天在西宁省新立村举行成立会议。

en.s: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 20 December 1962. They were the first after the end of the Trujillo dictatorship two years earlier, and are generally reckoned as the first truly free elections in the country's history. Juan Bosch of the Dominican Revolutionary Party won the presidential election, whilst his party also won the Congressional elections. There was also an election for a Constitutional Assembly, whose role was to amend certain articles of the constitution. However, reforms implemented by Bosch alienated the American government and the local oligarchy, leading to a coup the following year.

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于1962年12月20日举行大选。这是特鲁希略独裁统治两年前结束后举行的首次选举，通常被视为该国历史上第一次真正自由的选举。多米尼加革命党候选人胡安·博什赢得总统选举，该党也赢得国会选举；选民还选出了制宪会议，负责修订宪法中的部分条款。博什推行的改革后来疏远了美国政府和当地寡头，次年他遭遇政变。

en.t: 1972 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election
en.s: An election for the leadership of the Liberal Party of Australia took place on 20 December 1972, following former prime minister William McMahon's resignation after his defeat at the 1972 federal election. Billy Snedden was successful in winning the leadership, narrowly beating Nigel Bowen by 30 votes to 29 on the fifth ballot. The previous ballot was tied at 29 each, with one MP not voting.

zh.t: 1972年澳大利亚自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 1972年12月20日，澳大利亚自由党举行党魁选举。前总理威廉·麦克马洪在1972年联邦大选失利后辞职，促成这次选举。比利·斯内登在第五轮投票中以30票对29票险胜奈杰尔·鲍恩，当选党魁；上一轮投票中双方各得29票，一名议员未投票。

en.t: Spanish prime minister Luis Carrero Blanco is assassinated
en.s: On December 20, 1973, Spanish prime minister Luis Carrero Blanco was killed in Madrid when the Basque separatist group ETA detonated explosives beneath his car’s route.

zh.t: 西班牙首相卡雷罗·布兰科遇刺
zh.s: 1973年12月20日，西班牙首相路易斯·卡雷罗·布兰科在马德里遇刺身亡。巴斯克分离主义组织“埃塔”在其汽车行经的道路下方引爆炸药。

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 20 December 1976. They were the first general elections to be held since independence on 12 March 1968 and came nine years after the previous elections in 1967. Although elections had been scheduled for 1972, they were cancelled by the Labour Party–Parti Mauricien Social Démocrate–Muslim Committee of Action coalition government due to political unrest.

zh.s: 毛里求斯于1976年12月20日举行大选。这是该国1968年3月12日独立后举行的首次大选，距离1967年上次选举已有九年。原定于1972年举行的选举，因工党、毛里求斯社会民主党和穆斯林行动委员会组成的联合政府遭遇政治动荡而取消。

en.t: With the approval of the State Council, China's two largest newspapers, the People's Daily and the Guangming Daily, publish in full for the first time the Second Chinese Character Simplification Scheme
en.s: The State Council of China, synonymous with Central People's Government, is the supreme administrative organ of the country's unified state apparatus and the executive organ of the National People's Congress (NPC), the supreme organ of state power. It is composed of a premier, vice premiers, state councilors, ministers, chairpersons of commissions, an auditor-general, the governor of the People's Bank of China, and a secretary-general.

en.s: The Battle of Tripoli (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة طَرَابُلُس, romanized: Maʿrakat Ṭarābulus) was a major battle during the middle of the Lebanese Civil War in late 1983. It took place in the northern coastal city of Tripoli between pro-Syrian Palestinian militant factions and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) led by Yasser Arafat. It resulted in the withdrawal of PLO and mostly ended their involvement in the war.

en.t: Twelve-year-old Jonelle Matthews disappeared from her home in Greeley, Colorado; her body was not discovered until 2019
en.s: Jonelle Renee Matthews was a 12-year-old American girl who disappeared near Greeley, Colorado, on December 20, 1984. Her remains were discovered on July 24, 2019, by construction workers installing a new pipeline 15 miles (24 km) from her home. Steven Pankey was sentenced to life imprisonment on October 31, 2022, after his arrest and trial for Matthews's murder.

zh.t: 12岁女孩乔内尔·马修斯在科罗拉多州格里利的家中失踪，直到2019年才发现遗体
zh.s: 乔内尔·蕾妮·马修斯是一个12岁的美国女孩，于1984年12月20日在科罗拉多州格里利附近失踪。2019年7月24日，施工人员铺设新管道时，在距她家15英里（24公里）处发现她的遗骸。史蒂文·潘基因谋杀马修斯被捕、受审后，于2022年10月31日被判终身监禁。

en.t: The deadliest peacetime maritime disaster in history occurred when the MV Doña Paz (pictured) sank after colliding with an oil tanker in the Tablas Strait in the Philippines, resulting in an estimated 4,385 deaths
en.s: MV Doña Paz was a Japanese-built and Philippine-registered passenger ferry that sank after she collided with the oil tanker MT Vector on December 20, 1987. Built by Onomichi Dockyard Co., Ltd. (Onomichi Zosen) of Hiroshima, Japan, the ship was launched on April 25, 1963 as the Himeyuri Maru with a passenger capacity of 608. In October 1975, the Himeyuri Maru was bought by Sulpicio Lines and renamed the Don Sulpicio.

zh.t: 多娜·帕斯号沉没，成为史上最致命的和平时期海难，估计造成4385人死亡
zh.s: 多娜·帕斯号是一艘日本建造、在菲律宾注册的客运渡轮，1987年12月20日与油轮MT Vector相撞后沉没。该船由日本广岛县尾道造船株式会社建造，于1963年4月25日下水，最初名为姬百合丸，载客量为608人。1975年10月，船被Sulpicio Lines收购并更名为“唐·苏尔皮西奥号”。

en.t: United Nations Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances
en.s: The United Nations Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances of 1988 is one of three major drug control treaties currently in force. It provides additional legal mechanisms for enforcing the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs and the 1971 Convention on Psychotropic Substances. The Convention entered into force on November 11, 1990. As of June 2020, there are 191 Parties to the convention.
en.n: War on drugs: The United Nations agrees upon and promulgates the United Nations Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances, one of three major drug control treaties currently in force.

zh.t: 联合国禁止非法贩运麻醉药品和精神药物公约
zh.s: 1988年《联合国禁止非法贩运麻醉药品和精神药物公约》是目前生效的三大国际禁毒条约之一。该公约为执行1961年《麻醉品单一公约》和1971年《精神药物公约》提供了额外的法律机制。公约于1990年11月11日生效。截至2020年6月，共有191个缔约方。
zh.n: 毒品战争：联合国通过并颁布《联合国禁止非法贩运麻醉药品和精神药物公约》，该公约是目前生效的三大国际禁毒条约之一。

en.s: The Capture of Torrijos Airport took place as an opening action of the United States invasion of Panama, and was fought between the U.S. military and the Panama Defense Forces (PDF) on 20 December 1989. The goal of this operation was to capture the Panamanian Air Force, headquartered at the airport, and to close the airport to traffic coming into Panama.

zh.t: 托里霍斯机场夺取行动
zh.s: 托里霍斯机场夺取行动是美国入侵巴拿马初期的一项行动，交战双方为美军和巴拿马国防军。行动于1989年12月20日展开，目标是控制设在机场的巴拿马空军总部，并关闭机场，阻止人员和物资进入巴拿马。

en.s: The Battle of Rio Hato Airfield took place as an opening action of the United States invasion of Panama, and was fought between the U.S military and the Panama Defense Forces (PDF) on 20 December 1989. The action saw US paratroopers launch a surprise attack against the PDF at Rio Hato, the largest PDF military base in the country, approximately seventy miles south of Panama City.

zh.s: 里奥阿托机场战役是美国入侵巴拿马初期的一场战斗，于1989年12月20日由美军与巴拿马国防军交战。美军伞兵突袭了巴拿马国防军位于里奥阿托的最大军事基地，该基地位于巴拿马城以南约70英里处。

zh.s: 1989年12月20日，美国入侵巴拿马行动刚开始时，巴拿马国防军与美国海军海豹突击队在帕伊蒂利亚机场交战。美军由海豹突击队第四小队的48名成员组成，下辖高尔夫、布拉沃和德尔塔三个排，由帕特里克·图希中校指挥。

en.s: The United States invasion of Panama began in mid-December 1989 during the presidency of George H. W. Bush. The purpose of the invasion was to depose the de facto ruler of Panama, General Manuel Noriega, who was wanted by U.S. authorities for racketeering and drug trafficking. The operation, codenamed Operation Just Cause, concluded in late January 1990 with the surrender of Noriega.
en.n: The United States invasion of Panama deposes Manuel Noriega.

en.s: Operation Acid Gambit took place as an opening action of the United States invasion of Panama, on 20 December 1989. It was a U.S. Delta Force operation that retrieved Kurt Muse, a rumored asset of the Central Intelligence Agency, operating in Panama who had been arrested for leading a plot with other Panamanians to overthrow the government of Panama, from the Cárcel Modelo, a notorious prison in Panama City.

zh.s: 酸液行动是美国入侵巴拿马初期的一项行动，于1989年12月20日展开。美国三角洲部队从巴拿马城一座臭名昭著的监狱——模范监狱中救出了库尔特·穆斯。他被指曾与其他巴拿马人合谋推翻巴拿马政府，也有传闻称他是中央情报局的线人。

en.s: General elections were held in the Republic of Serbia on 20 December 1992. The elections were won by Slobodan Milošević and his Socialist Party of Serbia (SPS), which won 101 of the 250 seats in the National Assembly.

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 20 December 1995. The result was a landslide victory for the Labour Party-Mauritian Militant Movement alliance led by Navin Ramgoolam, which won all 60 constituency seats on Mauritius. Along with 1982, it was one of three elections in which a party won every seat. The Militant Socialist Movement (MSM) led by Anerood Jugnauth lost power after 13 years, with Jugnauth resigning two days after the results were announced.

zh.s: 毛里求斯于1995年12月20日举行大选。纳温·拉姆古兰领导的工党—毛里求斯战斗运动联盟大获全胜，赢得毛里求斯全部60个选区席位。这是历史上仅有的三个由单一政党赢得全部席位的选举之一，另一次发生于1982年。阿内罗德·贾格纳特领导的战斗社会主义运动在执政13年后失去政权，他在结果公布两天后辞职。

en.s: The Arena Naucalpan 21st Anniversary Show was a major annual professional wrestling event produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on December 20, 1998 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. As the name implies the show celebrated the 21st Anniversary of the construction of Arena Naucalpan, IWRG's main venue in 1977. zh.s: 《王者之王》是美国职业摔角联盟Major League Wrestling（MLW）举办的一场大型赛事，于2002年12月20日在佛罗里达州劳德代尔堡战争纪念礼堂举行。赛事共进行了九场职业摔角比赛。主赛中，小岛聪击败吸血鬼（Vampiro），卫冕MLW世界重量级冠军。

en.t: KCR West Rail opens in Hong Kong
en.s: Hong Kong’s Kowloon–Canton Railway Corporation opened West Rail on December 20, 2003, connecting communities in the northwestern New Territories with urban Kowloon. The route later became the West Rail Line and is now part of the MTR Tuen Ma line.

zh.t: 香港九广铁路西铁通车
zh.s: 2003年12月20日，香港九广铁路公司开通西铁，连接新界西北多个社区与九龙市区。这条铁路后来称为西铁线，如今是港铁屯马线的一部分。

zh.s: 这是第47届全爱尔兰女子高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛，也是2020年全爱尔兰女子高级盖尔式足球锦标赛的冠军决胜战，赛事由爱尔兰各郡队伍参赛。受新冠疫情影响，比赛没有观众。上半场科克队以一球领先，但都柏林队在下半场反超，连续第四年夺冠。

en.s: The 2022 Gambian coup attempt was a military coup d'état attempt which took place in The Gambia on 20 December 2022. Reportedly, some soldiers attempted to overthrow the government of President Adama Barrow. Four soldiers were arrested on suspicion of involvement. The Gambian military initially denied that any such coup attempt took place. It also went after three other alleged conspirators.

zh.s: 2022年12月20日，冈比亚发生未遂军事政变。据报道，部分士兵企图推翻总统阿达马·巴罗政府，4名士兵因涉嫌参与而被捕。冈比亚军方起初否认发生过政变企图，之后又追查另外3名被指为共谋者的人。

en.t: 2022 Bannu counterterrorism centre attack and siege
en.s: On 18 December 2022, the Pakistani Taliban carried out an attack on a counterterrorism centre in the Bannu District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. They took the officers hostage until 20 December, when Pakistan's security forces lay siege to the centre, releasing all the hostages and killing 25 militants inside. Two officers were killed during the siege.

zh.t: 2022年班努反恐中心袭击与围困事件
zh.s: 2022年12月18日，巴基斯坦塔利班袭击了开伯尔-普什图省班努县的一处反恐中心，并扣押了警员。直到12月20日，巴基斯坦安全部队才包围该中心，救出全部人质，并击毙中心内的25名武装分子。围困期间有两名警员遇害。

en.t: 2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 20 December 2023. Combined elections were held for the President, 484 of the 500 members of the National Assembly, 700 of the 716 elected members of the 26 provincial assemblies, and for the first time under the new constitution, 951 members of a scaled down number of commune (municipal) councils.

zh.s: 刚果民主共和国于2023年12月20日举行大选，同时选举总统、国民议会500席中的484席、26个省议会716个民选席位中的700席；新宪法实施后，首次选举缩编后的市镇议会，共951席。

en.s: The 2023 Territory Labor Party leadership election was held on 20 December 2023 to elect a new leader of the Territory Labor Party and ex officio, Chief Minister of the Northern Territory, following the resignation of Natasha Fyles as Chief Minister. Eva Lawler was elected unopposed on 20 December. The only other declared candidate, Nicole Manison, chose to support Lawler and decided to move to the backbench following the election.

zh.s: 2023年12月20日，北领地工党举行党魁选举，选出新任党魁及当然兼任的北领地首席部长。此次选举是在首席部长娜塔莎·法尔斯辞职后举行，伊娃·劳勒在无人竞争的情况下当选。唯一宣布参选的另一名候选人妮可·马尼森选择支持劳勒，并决定在选举后转任后座议员。

en.s: The 2023 Albanian Supercup was the 30th edition of the Albanian Supercup, an annual Albanian football match. The teams were decided by taking the trophy winners of the previous season's Kategoria Superiore champions and the winners of the Albanian Cup. The match was contested by Partizani, champions of the 2022–23 Kategoria Superiore, and Egnatia, the 2022–23 Albanian Cup winners.

zh.s: 2023年阿尔巴尼亚超级杯是该项年度足球赛事的第30届。参赛球队由上赛季阿尔巴尼亚足球超级联赛冠军和阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军组成，分别是2022—2023赛季联赛冠军地拉那游击队和阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军埃格纳蒂亚队。

en.s: On 20 December 2024, an SUV was driven into a crowd at the Christmas market in Magdeburg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany, killing 6 people and injuring 309 others. The driver of the car, 50-year-old anti-Islam activist Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen, was arrested at the scene. German authorities have described the perpetrator as an Islamophobe. Investigators continue to search for a motive, which remains unknown.

zh.t: 2024年马格德堡圣诞市场汽车冲撞事件
zh.s: 2024年12月20日，一辆SUV冲入德国萨克森-安哈尔特州马格德堡圣诞市场的人群，造成6人死亡、309人受伤。驾驶员、50岁的反伊斯兰活动人士塔勒比·阿卜杜勒穆森当场被捕。德国当局称其为仇视伊斯兰者。调查人员仍在寻找作案动机，目前动机尚不明确。

en.s: In September 2024, the Arakan Army (AA) launched an offensive to capture the town of Ann in Myanmar, the location of the headquarters of the Myanmar military's Western Command. The battle was a culmination of a year-long offensive by the Arakan Army to capture the entirety of Rakhine State. The battle ultimately resulted in the total defeat of junta forces on 20 December 2024 and the capture of Ann and Ann Airport by Arakan Army forces.

zh.s: 若开军于2024年9月发动攻势，试图夺取缅甸安镇及缅军西部军区总部所在地。此战是若开军为控制整个若开邦而发动的持续一年攻势的高潮。2024年12月20日，若开军彻底击败缅甸军政府部队，并攻占安镇和安镇机场。
